responsibility: Implements libgdiagnostics, GCC’s standalone C API for constructing and emitting diagnostics outside the compiler’s internal call sites. This file owns the backing C++ data structures behind the opaque C handles—diagnostic managers, files, physical/logical locations, diagnostics, and execution paths—plus validation, source-content caching, sink creation, fix-it/path attachment, and final emission through GCC’s text and SARIF formatting infrastructure.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation half of libgdiagnostics: unlike gcc/libgdiagnostics.h, which declares the exported C API and opaque types, it defines the backing C++ structs and the actual API entrypoints that validate inputs, manage state, and route emitted diagnostics into GCC’s text and SARIF formatters.
